summary: Iteration 2 backend + frontend testing complete. 24/24 pytest tests passed (previous 21 + 3 new for MJ persona: MJ=MAJA/owner=Sam, founders with exact LinkedIn URLs, and real services list — all with no ** markdown). All frontend requirements verified: certificate popup auto-appears on '/' within ~2s, has correct header/steps/CTA/close, once-per-session (no reappear after navigating to /about), CTA closes popup + opens MJ panel with mj-input focused & prefilled 'VERIFY '. Launcher shows Marca Rise logo image (no sparkle/diamond); desktop bottom-left (24,992), mobile 390x844 at left-middle (16, center-y=448.75) with no overlap on Book-a-call widget (bottom-right). Welcome starts 'Hey! I'm MAJA — but Sam calls me MJ'; quick actions are exactly Verify My Certificate / Our Services ✨ / Meet Founder / About Marca Rise (no 'Talk with MJ' or 'Meet CEO'). Meet Founder reply mentions Sam & Sanjay with 2 clickable <a> tags to https://www.linkedin.com/in/princesamuel69/ and https://www.linkedin.com/in/sanjay-sid/. Services quick action lists Social Media, Short Form, Branding, Web Design, UI/UX, Content Strategy. VERIFY MR00-XX-00000 renders cert-card-verified with Arun Kumar + CRM Management System. Admin login at /admin with saxluyz@gmail.com/1234 opens dashboard (admin-cert-table); wrong password shows admin-login-error 'Invalid email or password'. No Admin link in navbar/footer. Book-a-call widget bottom-right intact and functional.

rca of the issue: N/A — no bugs. Only UX nit: CertificatePopup is mounted globally in App.tsx alongside MarcaAIChat + CalendlyCard, so it also renders over /admin on first visit until dismissed. Reproduction: open https://<host>/admin in a fresh session — popup overlays the login form. Mitigation: gate <CertificatePopup /> mount to non-/admin routes, or add a route check inside the component (e.g., if window.location.pathname.startsWith('/admin') return null).
